items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: Milt Hinton and I joined the band the same day.

ctx.x: Yeah. Milt Hinton and I joined the band the same day.
I’ll be darned. We’ve been trying to get different people’s different takes on what made the Basie rhythm section the Basie rhythm section. It’s like a term in jazz, you know? And what was that?
